t: Change Impact Analyzer - public implementations survey
title: Change Impact Analyzer - public implementations survey
definition: Identifies components affected by a proposed modification.
description:
Change Impact Analyzer is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Identifies components affected by a proposed modification. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Change Impact Analyzer. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Change Impact Analyzer. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Change Impact Analyzer capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

title: Mercurial - related Change Impact Analyzer technology
definition: Clean distributed VCS alternative.
description:
Mercurial is not itself a Change Impact Analyzer, but it belongs in this survey because real Change Impact Analyzer work leans on it. Clean distributed VCS alternative.

In a Change Impact Analyzer build it shows up when the team already lives in its ecosystem. The design favors boring reliability over cleverness: well-trodden paths, clear errors, and behavior you can reason about without reading the source. Knowing the surrounding technology is part of knowing the capability - the best Change Impact Analyzer practitioners can say exactly where their tool ends and its neighbors begin.

For builders, Mercurial is a dependable workhorse as supporting technology. The demo program exercises a core idea from its domain - run it with node and watch each step.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Change Impact Ana
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Change Impact Ana
definition: Ladder drill (foundation): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Change Impact Analyzer from a one-paragraph brief.
description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Change Impact Analyzer from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Change Impact Analyzer needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
